output.brief: The crash gap is not caused by the Tiled Canvas flag. It is caused by build 7.4.0, most likely its upgrade of the Pixelda image library to 3.1. The top crash cluster (41% of 7.4.0 crash events) is a native SIGSEGV in libpixelda.so HEIF decoding. It is absent from 7.3.2 and first appeared on 2 Sep, before the flag ramp started on 4 Sep. The flag-on and flag-off groups inside 7.4.0 crash at nearly the same rate (2.10% vs 1.98%, interval includes zero). Both 7.4.0 groups are about three times 7.3.2. The app store's independent console shows the same gap, so the crash-reporting SDK upgrade is unlikely to be the cause. The sync deployment does not explain it either, since 7.3.2 did not change after 9 Sep. I am fairly confident, but the library cause is not yet confirmed; the stack does not show which screen made the call. Do not turn the flag off as the fix, and do not close the incident or go to 100% on 18 Sep. Hold 7.4.0 at 25%, prioritise a fix for the Pixelda HEIF crash, and confirm the cause in a test build. Do not roll back the SDK, since that would hide evidence.
